marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Wish to see you again. Part 1

Apart more often than not, F4 members finally reunite on television in the new CTS drama "Wish To See You Again". Teaming up for the first time since 2003's Love Storm, Vic Chou and Ken Chu share top billing in this highly anticipated romantic drama from the producer and director of Why Why Love, Corner with Love, and Devil Beside You. Band mate Vanness Wu also takes a supporting role, along with idol drama favorite Kingone Wang (Devil Beside You). The lucky ladies this time around are Taiwan beauty Terri Kwan (La Robe De Mariage Des Cieux) and newcomer Michelle Chen from Why Why Love. The drama's impressive extended cast also includes Eric Tsang, Abe Tsuyoshi, Tien Hsin, Anthony Bao, and Megan Lai. As a sign of F4's longstanding popularity in Asia, Wish To See You Again actually aired first in Japan in December 2007 before arriving on Taiwan TV screens in early 2008
